name: veycraft
description: Veycraft — Agent-native career operations & Profile Intelligence Engine for the AI agent you already use. Zero-dependency CLI, 56 Markdown skills, truthful CV tailoring, and human APPROVE gates.

scripts.test: node ./bin/cli.mjs eval --baseline && node ./bin/cli.mjs eval --file evals/results/live-agent-eval-run.json && node ./bin/cli.mjs eval --journeys
scripts.pack:check: node -e "const cp=require('node:child_process');const raw=cp.execSync('npm pack --dry-run --json',{encoding:'utf8'});const p=JSON.parse(raw.slice(raw.indexOf('[')))[0];const paths=p.files.map(f=>f.path);const bad=paths.filter(x=>/context\/(?!.*\.example$|DROP_YOUR_FILES_HERE\.md$)|^logs\/|^tracker\/|\.pdf$|^\.env|browser-profile|\.veycraft\.bak$/i.test(x));if(bad.length)throw new Error('Blocked sensitive files in tarball: '+bad.join(', '));for(const req of ['bin/cli.mjs','bin/core-ops.mjs','bin/mcp-server.mjs','bin/ui-server.mjs','bin/fs-safety.mjs','bin/career-intelligence.mjs','bin/notion-sync.mjs','bin/profile-intelligence.mjs','bin/fast-ops.mjs','bin/browser-payloads.mjs','ui/index.html','ui/styles.css','ui/app.js','ui/favicon.svg','glama.json','AGENTS.md','skills/REGISTRY.md','.github/copilot-instructions.md','.github/CODEOWNERS','PROVENANCE.json','NOTICE']){if(!paths.includes(req))throw new Error('Missing required package file: '+req);}console.log('pack:check OK ->',p.filename,p.entryCount,'files,',p.size,'bytes');"
scripts.prepublishOnly: node --check bin/fs-safety.mjs && node --check bin/core-ops.mjs && node --check bin/mcp-server.mjs && node --check bin/ui-server.mjs && node --check ui/app.js && node --check bin/career-intelligence.mjs && node --check bin/notion-sync.mjs && node --check bin/cli.mjs && node --check bin/profile-intelligence.mjs && node --check bin/fast-ops.mjs && node --check bin/browser-payloads.mjs && npm test && npm run pack:check
